releaseNotes: PRODUCTION DB FIX: Applied Prisma migration to add isArchived/archivedAt/archivedBy columns to Member table, BackupLog table, and Complaint fields — resolves 'column does not exist' error on Render production server.
FAST SPLASH: Reduced splash screen loading time from ~7s to ~3.5s by cutting update-check timeout (4500ms → 1500ms) and minimum splash display (2800ms → 1800ms).
PAYMENT SCREENSHOT PREVIEW: Admin can now view member payment screenshots inline (thumbnail + pinch-to-zoom modal) in both Payment Verification and 6-Month History screens.
PORTAL UPLOAD FIX: Robust phone sanitization prevents Prisma invocation errors when members submit payment screenshots through the web portal.
title: Chintamani Library v2.8.10 — Fast Splash + Production DB Fix
